# Figure 2: Interindividual trait variability

## Load other size data
Main Fig 2: Show results for prosome length (major axis length for RF), wax ester carbon. Show LOKI values per stage. Show literature values from database
```{r}
loki.segmentations <- read.csv("data/LOKI_Bourreau_manuscript/merged_LOKI2013_ecotaxa_masks_features.csv") %>% 
 
# match trait names
  mutate(total_carbon = prosome_carbon_volume + total_lipids_ugC/1000,
         # lf_carbon = fullness_ratio_carbon_volume * 100,
         lf_carbon = total_lipids_ugC/1000 / total_carbon * 100,
         waxester_carbon = total_lipids_ugC / 1000) %>% 
  #  # Recalculated version (lipid carbon not based on the variable total_lipids_carbon_volume)
  # mutate(lf_carbon = waxester_carbon / (waxester_carbon + prosome_carbon_volume) * 100) %>% 
  select(object_id, object_annotation_category,
         prosome_length_mm = prosome_major_axis_mm,
         prosome_biovolume_mm3 = prosome_volume_mm3,
         structural_carbon = prosome_carbon_volume,
         waxester_carbon,
         total_carbon, lf_carbon) %>% 
  mutate(source = "LOKI segmented")


loki.segmentations <- loki.segmentations %>% 
  mutate(scientificName = case_when(
    object_annotation_category %in% c("female+lateral<Calanus hyperboreus",
                                      "cvstage+lateral<Calanus hyperboreus",
                                      "civstage+lateral<Calanus hyperboreus") ~ "Calanus hyperboreus",
    object_annotation_category %in% c("female+lateral<Calanus glacialis",
                                      "cvstage+lateral<Calanus glacialis",
                                      "civstage+lateral<Calanus glacialis") ~ "Calanus glacialis",
  )) %>% 
  mutate(taxa = case_when(
    object_annotation_category == "female+lateral<Calanus hyperboreus" ~ "C. hyperboreus F",
    object_annotation_category == "cvstage+lateral<Calanus hyperboreus" ~ "C. hyperboreus CV",
    object_annotation_category == "civstage+lateral<Calanus hyperboreus" ~ "C. hyperboreus CIV",
    object_annotation_category == "female+lateral<Calanus glacialis" ~ "C. glacialis F",
    object_annotation_category == "cvstage+lateral<Calanus glacialis" ~ "C. glacialis CV",
    object_annotation_category == "civstage+lateral<Calanus glacialis" ~ "C. glacialis CIV",
    TRUE ~ object_annotation_category
  ) ) %>% 
  mutate(lifeStage = case_when(
    object_annotation_category %in% c("female+lateral<Calanus hyperboreus",
                                      "female+lateral<Calanus glacialis") ~ "F",
    object_annotation_category %in% c("cvstage+lateral<Calanus hyperboreus",
                                      "cvstage+lateral<Calanus glacialis") ~ "CV",
    object_annotation_category %in% c("civstage+lateral<Calanus hyperboreus",
                                      "civstage+lateral<Calanus glacialis") ~ "CIV",
  ))



## Get Trait Database values
load( "data/literature_prosome_lengths_20260317.RData")

# For prosome length, combine the LOKI and literature information
prosome.lit <- calanus.prosome.length %>% 
  rename(taxa = scientificNameStage,
         prosome_length_mm = prosomeLength) %>% 
  mutate(source = "Literature") %>% 
  filter(lifeStage != "CIII") %>% 
  droplevels() %>% 
  bind_rows(
    loki.segmentations %>% 
      select(taxa, source, prosome_length_mm,
             scientificName, lifeStage) ) %>% 
  mutate(scientificName = factor(scientificName,
                                 levels = c("Calanus hyperboreus",
                                            "Calanus glacialis",
                                            "Calanus finmarchicus")))

ggplot(prosome.lit,
       aes(x = prosome_length_mm, y = lifeStage, color = source))+
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(2:10), limits = c(1.42, 8.8)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("purple","black"),
                                name = "Data source") +
  xlab("Prosome length (mm)") +
  facet_wrap(~scientificName, ncol = 1) + 
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        strip.placement = "inside",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold.italic",
                                  size = 16,
                                  hjust = 0),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        
        # legend inside bottom-right
    legend.position = c(0.98, 0.02),
    legend.justification = c(1, 0),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )
```


## Figure 2
```{r}
df_to_plot <- indiv_traits %>% 
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") %>% 
  # Change the data source tag to simply model prediction for the main figure
  mutate(source = if_else(source %in% c("CNN segmentation", "Random Forest"),
                          "Model prediction", source)) %>% 
  mutate(source = factor(source, levels = c("Model prediction","Manual segmentation")))
  
# For Fig 2c, calculate values if no interindividual variability 
# Assume median in situ temperature and lipid fullness
median_temp <- median(df_to_plot$temperature_kelvin, na.rm = T) #-273.15 = -0.13
median_fullness <- median(df_to_plot$lipid_fullness, na.rm = T)/100
bb <- 2.27# Metabolic constant (x 10-7)
eV <- 0.6 # Activation energy
no_traitvar <- indiv_traits %>% 
  filter(taxa == "Calanus") %>% 
  distinct(prosome_total_mgC,
           orig_respirationRate_ugCday = respirationRate_ugCday) %>% 
  mutate(new_mass_ugC = prosome_total_mgC * 1000 * (1-median_fullness),
         waxester_mass_mgC = prosome_total_mgC * median_fullness,
         waxester_mass_ugC = waxester_mass_mgC * 1000) %>% 
  
  mutate(respirationRate_ugCday = 
           (bb*10^-7 ) * (new_mass_ugC^0.75) * 
           exp(eV * (median_temp-273)/ 
                 ((8.62*10^-5)*median_temp*273)) * 86400) %>%
  mutate(diapauseDuration_day = 
           (0.8*waxester_mass_ugC)/(respirationRate_ugCday)) 

# # only include the samples in the final analysis?
#   filter(sample_id %notin% excluded_profiles$sample_id)

clrs <- c("hotpink","deepskyblue")


g1 <- ggplot(df_to_plot,
             aes(x = prosome_length_mm, fill = source)) +
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.9, position = "stack", bins = 50) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clrs, name = "Data source") +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = 2:10, limits = c(1.5, 8.5),
                expand = c(0,0)) +
  xlab("Prosome length (mm)") +
  ylab("# Individuals") +
  facet_wrap(~taxa, ncol = 1) + 
  theme(strip.placement = "inside",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold.italic", hjust = 0,
                                  size = 16),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        # legend.position = c(0.2, 0.85),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        legend.key = element_blank())


g2 <- ggplot(prosome.lit,
             aes(x = prosome_length_mm, y = lifeStage, color = source))+
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(2:10), limits = c(1.5, 8.5),
                expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("purple","black"),
                     name = "Data source") +
  xlab("Prosome length (mm)") +
  ylab("Life stage") +
  facet_wrap(~scientificName, ncol = 1) + 
  theme(strip.placement = "inside",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold.italic", hjust = 0,
                                  size = 16),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        
        # legend.position = c(0.98, 0.02), # c(0.28, 0.8)
        # legend.justification = c(1, 0),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA))

g3 <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = df_to_plot %>%
         mutate(Temperature = temperature_kelvin - 273.15),
       aes(x = waxester_mass_mgC, y = respirationRate_ugCday,
           color = Temperature), alpha = 0.5) +
  
  # if no interindividual variability
  geom_point(data = no_traitvar,
             aes(x = waxester_mass_mgC, y = respirationRate_ugCday),
             shape = 1, color = "firebrick2") +
  
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 3.2), expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "(°C)") +
  xlab("Wax ester carbon (mg C)") +
  ylab("Diapause respiration rate (\u03bcg C day⁻¹)")+
  theme(legend.position = c(0.1, 0.78), # c(0.9, 0.2),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
        legend.key = element_blank())


g4 <- ggplot(df_to_plot %>% 
               arrange(prosome_length_mm),
       aes(x = lipid_fullness, y = diapauseDuration_day)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = prosome_length_mm), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 240, color = "gray50", size = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo", name = "Prosome\nlength (mm)") +
  xlab("Lipid fullness (%)")+
  ylab("Potential diapause duration (day)") +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.15, 0.75),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
        legend.key = element_blank())
  
# Add histograms
g3 <- ggExtra::ggMarginal(g3, type = "histogram", bins = 50, 
                          size = 10, fill = "gray")
g4 <- ggExtra::ggMarginal(g4, type = "histogram", bins = 50, 
                    size = 10, fill = "gray")

  
cowplot::plot_grid(
  plot_grid(g1,g2, ncol = 1, align = "v", labels = c("a","b"),
            rel_heights = c(1.33,1)),
  plot_grid(g3,g4, ncol = 1, align = "v", labels = c("c","d")),
  nrow = 1)

ggsave("figures/Figure2_March_20260428.png",
       width = 12, height = 10, units = "in", bg = "white")
```

## Fig3d biomass with standard errors
```{r}
biomass_vert_region <- df.station.100m %>% 
  # Add metadata
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
              distinct(station_year, .keep_all = T) %>% 
              select(station_year, reg.inuk, 
                     Year, bottom_depth_m),
            by = "station_year") %>% 
  group_by(reg.inuk, Depth_100m) %>% 
  summarise(nprofiles = n(),
            across(Sampled_volume_m3:total_gC_flux_m2,
              list(mean = mean, sd = sd),
              na.rm = TRUE), 
            .groups = "drop")  %>% 
  select(reg.inuk, Depth_100m, nprofiles,
         abundance_m3 = abundance_m3_mean, biomass_m3 = biomass_mgC_m3_mean,
         biomass_mgC_m3_sd,
         lipid_m3 = waxester_mgC_m3_mean) %>% 
  # calculate total across all taxa
  group_by(reg.inuk, Depth_100m, nprofiles) %>% 
  mutate(total_abundance_m3 = sum(abundance_m3), 
         total_biomass_m3 = sum(biomass_m3),
         total_lipid_m3 = sum(lipid_m3)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(Depth_100m = as.numeric(as.character(Depth_100m)) + 50) 

# Updated: use nprofiles >= 3 to allow stats. This excludes the last bins with few profiles included.
biomass_vert_region_to_plot <- biomass_vert_region %>% 
  group_by(reg.inuk) %>% 
  filter(nprofiles >= 3) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(biomass_mgC_m3_se = biomass_mgC_m3_sd / sqrt(nprofiles))


p4 <- ggplot(biomass_vert_region_to_plot,
             aes(x = Depth_100m, y = biomass_m3,
                 color = reg.inuk)) +

  geom_ribbon(aes( ymin = biomass_m3 - biomass_mgC_m3_se,
                    ymax = biomass_m3 + biomass_mgC_m3_se,
                   fill = reg.inuk),
               alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(alpha = 1) +
  # geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = biomass_m3 - biomass_mgC_m3_se,
  #                   ymax = biomass_m3 + biomass_mgC_m3_se),
  #               alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_point(shape = 16, size = 2) +
  
  # geom_line(aes(y = lipid_m3), linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.8) +
  # geom_point(aes(y = lipid_m3), shape = 1, size = 1) +
  geom_bar(aes(y = lipid_m3, fill = reg.inuk),
           color = "white", stat = "identity") +
  
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_reverse(breaks = seq(0,2500,200), expand = c(0.01,0.01)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01,0.01),
              labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = unique(clrs),
                     name = "Region") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = unique(clrs),
                     name = "Region") +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 16)
        ) +
  xlab("Depth (m)") + ylab("Biomass (mg C m⁻³)") +
  facet_wrap(~reg.inuk, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x", nrow = 1)
```

## Prepare data frames
```{r}
df_to_plot <- df.region %>%
  mutate(total_gC_flux_m2_se = total_gC_flux_m2_sd / sqrt(n))

# Lengthen to plot flux components
df.region.long <- df_to_plot %>% 
  select(region.inuktitut, reg.inuk, 
         `diapause respiration` = respired_C_gC_m2_mean, 
         `mortality structural` = structural_gC_m2_mort_mean, 
         `mortality storage` = waxester_gC_m2_mort_mean) %>%  
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`diapause respiration`, 
                        `mortality structural`, `mortality storage`),
               names_to = "Component", values_to = "Cflux") %>% 
  mutate(Component = if_else(Component == "diapause respiration",
                             "Respiration", Component),
         Component = if_else(Component == "mortality structural",
                             "Structural C", Component),
         Component = if_else(Component == "mortality storage",
                             "Storage C", Component)) %>% 
  mutate(Component = factor(Component,
                            levels = c("Storage C",
                                       "Structural C",
                                       "Respiration")))
```


## A: Lipid pump carbon flux
```{r}
# Reorder the regions
label_levels <- df_to_plot %>%
  mutate(region_label = paste0(reg.inuk, "\n(n=", n,")")) %>% 
  distinct(reg.inuk, region_label) %>%
  arrange(match(reg.inuk, levels(region_rename$reg.inuk))) %>%
  pull(region_label)

clrs <- c("firebrick2","sienna1","goldenrod2","forestgreen",
          "blue1","purple2","deeppink1")


np1 <- ggplot(df.profile,
       aes(y = reg.inuk)) +
  geom_violin(aes(x = total_gC_flux_m2, fill = reg.inuk),
              scale = "width", color = "white", alpha = 0.4) +
  
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = total_gC_flux_m2, fill = reg.inuk),
              color = "gray30", alpha = 0.6, width = 0.2) +
  
 # MEAN (solid blue vertical line)
  geom_linerange(data = df_to_plot,
                 aes(x = total_gC_flux_m2_mean,
                     ymin = after_stat(y) - 0.3, ymax = after_stat(y) + 0.3),
                 color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  
  
  scale_color_manual(values = unique(clrs)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = unique(clrs)) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev, labels = rev(label_levels)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,13,1), expand = c(0,0)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 8.2)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  xlab("LPC flux (g C m⁻² y⁻¹)") + ylab("Region")

np1
```

## B: Flux components
```{r}
np2 <- ggplot(df.region.long,
       aes(x = reg.inuk)) +
  
  ggpattern::geom_col_pattern(aes(y = Cflux, fill = reg.inuk, 
                                  pattern = Component, 
                                  alpha = Component),
                              # position = "fill",
                              stat = "identity", color = "black",
                              pattern_color = "white",
                              pattern_spacing = 0.02,
                              pattern_density = 0.1) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = clrs,
                    guide = "none") +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(0.4, 0.7, 1),
                     guide = "none") +
  ggpattern::scale_pattern_manual(values = c("circle","stripe","none")) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.box.just = "left",
        legend.box = "horizontal",
        legend.location = "plot" ) +
  ylab("LPC flux (g C m⁻² y⁻¹)") +

  coord_flip() +
  guides(alpha = guide_legend(title.hjust = 0.5, nrow = 1, reverse = T),
         pattern = guide_legend(title.hjust = 0.5, nrow = 1, reverse = T))

np2
```


## C: POC flux comparison
```{r}
np3 <- ggplot() +
  geom_abline() +
  
  # For 200 m points
  geom_errorbar(data = flux.comp.200, 
                aes(xmin = lipid_gC_m2_yr_mean-lipid_gC_m2_yr_sd,
                    xmax = lipid_gC_m2_yr_mean+lipid_gC_m2_yr_sd,
                    y = poc_gC_m2_yr_mean,
                    color = region_label),
                width = 0, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_errorbar(data = flux.comp.200, 
                aes(ymin = poc_gC_m2_yr_mean-poc_gC_m2_yr_sd,
                    ymax = poc_gC_m2_yr_mean+poc_gC_m2_yr_sd,
                    x = lipid_gC_m2_yr_mean,
                    color = region_label),
                width = 0, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_point(data = flux.comp.200, 
             aes(x = lipid_gC_m2_yr_mean, 
                 y = poc_gC_m2_yr_mean,
                 fill = region_label),
             shape = 21, alpha = 0.9, size = 4, color ="black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clrs,
                    name = "C flux at 200 m",
                    guide = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = clrs,
                     guide = "none")  +
  
  # For 500 m points
  ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +
  geom_errorbar(data = flux.comp.500,
                aes(xmin = lipid_gC_m2_yr_mean-lipid_gC_m2_yr_sd,
                    xmax = lipid_gC_m2_yr_mean+lipid_gC_m2_yr_sd,
                    y = poc_gC_m2_yr_mean,
                    color = region_label),
                width = 0, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(data = flux.comp.500,
                aes(ymin = poc_gC_m2_yr_mean-poc_gC_m2_yr_sd,
                    ymax = poc_gC_m2_yr_mean+poc_gC_m2_yr_sd,
                    x = lipid_gC_m2_yr_mean,
                    color = region_label),
                width = 0, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("sienna1","goldenrod2",
                                "forestgreen","blue1"),
                     guide = "none")  +
  
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_point(data = flux.comp.500,
             aes(x = lipid_gC_m2_yr_mean, 
                 y = poc_gC_m2_yr_mean,
                 fill = region_label),
             shape = 23, alpha = 0.7, size = 4, color ="black",
             name = "C flux at 500 m") +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values =c("sienna1","goldenrod2",
                                "forestgreen","blue1"),
                    name = "C flux at 500 m",
                    guide = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE))  +
  
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,20,1), expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0,20,1), expand = c(0,0)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 8), ylim = c(0, 11.5)) +
  
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.box = "vertical") +
  xlab("LPC flux (g C m⁻² y⁻¹)"  )+
  ylab("POC flux (g C m⁻² y⁻¹)") 

np3

# Calculate LPC%POC flux
flux.comp.200 <- flux.comp.200 %>% 
  mutate(lipid_gC_m2_yr_mean/poc_gC_m2_yr_mean * 100)
flux.comp.500 <- flux.comp.500 %>% 
  mutate(lipid_gC_m2_yr_mean/poc_gC_m2_yr_mean * 100)
```
